collect.remainder: The remaining {amount} stays open as a new installment.

errors.exceeds: The amount must be lower than {max}. To collect everything, choose full amount.

bulk.all_or_nothing: Either all installments are collected or none: if one is not valid, nothing is changed.
bulk.failed: Nothing was collected. Please try again.

reconciliation.title: Bank reconciliation
reconciliation.intro: Upload your bank statement. We match each movement with an open installment; you decide which matches to accept before anything is recorded.
reconciliation.too_big: The file is larger than 2 MB.

invoice.title: Payment schedule
invoice.reopen_confirm: Reopen this installment? The collection will be undone.
invoice.load_failed: The payment schedule could not be loaded.

reminders.title: Payment reminders
reminders.dry_text: You can review who would be notified, but no email will be sent until sending is turned on.
reminders.active_text: Sending is on: reminders you confirm will really be sent.
reminders.rules: Notice {notice} days before the due date; reminder from {overdue} days overdue, repeated every {repeat} days.
reminders.uncertain: We did not receive confirmation of the sending and it was not retried. Check the result before sending again.
reminders.send_disabled: Sending is turned off: you can only review the list.
reminders.confirm_text: Reminders will be sent to {n} customer(s).

online.title: Collect by card
online.hint: Stripe's secure payment page will open in a new window. The payment is confirmed when Stripe notifies it, not when that window is closed.
online.processing_hint: Complete the payment in the open window. This screen will update by itself once it is confirmed.
online.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the payment window. Open it with the button.
online.expired: The payment session has expired. Close and start a new collection.
online.gave_up: We stopped checking automatically. Press Refresh to check again.

errors.not_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.invalid: Enter an amount with up to 2 decimals.

error.declined: The payment was declined. Try another card.
error.conflict: The collection cannot be started: one is already in progress for this invoice, nothing is pending, or the request was repeated with different data.
error.invalid: The collection data is not valid. Check the amount.
error.not_active: Online collection is not active for this account. Set up a gateway in Settings.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to collect online.
error.other: The collection could not be started. Please try again.

result.succeeded: Payment received. The invoice will be updated.

pending.title: Invoices awaiting payment
pending.intro: Issued invoices with an outstanding amount, sorted by due date. Collect by card online from each row.
pending.empty: There are no invoices awaiting payment.
pending.in_progress_hint: A payment of {amount} is in progress.

reason.currency: Online collection is only available in EUR.
reason.in_progress: Payment in progress: wait for it to be confirmed.
reason.unknown: This invoice cannot be collected online right now.

error.forbidden: You do not have permission to view invoices awaiting payment.
error.unavailable: The pending invoices could not be retrieved. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.other: The list could not be loaded. Please try again.

surcharges.title: Surcharges
surcharges.intro: Additional charges to your customers when the carrier measures more weight or volume than declared. They are proposed with a reason and evidence, the customer is notified and, once the notice period has passed, they are charged with the authorization the customer signed. You only see your own company's.
surcharges.transfer_hint: Surcharges TMWE collected as a fallback in your favour and has not yet transferred to you. Information only: no money moves here.
surcharges.empty: There are no surcharges to show.
surcharges.admin_hint: Waiving, rejecting a dispute and charging require the payments administrator permission.

notify.title: Notify the customer
notify.body: The customer will be notified. From then on the notice period and the dispute period start running; once the notice has passed you can charge it. Repeating the notice does not restart the periods.

dispute.title: Dispute on behalf of the customer
dispute.body: Records the customer's dispute. A disputed surcharge is not charged until the administrator resolves it.

waive.title: Waive the surcharge
waive.body: The surcharge is no longer payable. If it was already collected, a refund to the customer is requested. This decision is recorded with the reason.

reject_dispute.title: Reject the dispute
reject_dispute.body: The surcharge is considered valid: it goes back to charged without being charged twice, or it is charged now if it never was.

charge.title: Charge the surcharge
charge.body: The customer will be charged now with the authorization they signed, without being present. It is only possible once the notice period has passed and if automatic charging is active on the server.

done.waive_refund: Surcharge waived; a refund has been requested.
done.propose: Surcharge proposed. The customer has not been notified yet.
done.propose_replayed: That surcharge already existed; no new one was created.

result.pending: Charge in progress: it will be confirmed shortly.
result.requires_invoice: It could not be charged with the authorization: it will be claimed by invoice.
result.waiting: Waiting for the next charge attempt.

errors.not_active: Gateway surcharges and authorizations are not active in this environment.
errors.return_url: The return address for sign-up is not configured on the server.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation. Viewing surcharges and authorizations requires payment gateway permissions; waiving, rejecting disputes and charging also require being your company's payments administrator.
errors.not_found: Not found: it does not exist or does not belong to your company.
errors.cap_exceeded: The amount exceeds the allowed cap per charge or per month, or what the customer accepted.
errors.currency: Only surcharges in euros are supported.
errors.invalid: The data is not valid. Check the form.
errors.notice_not_elapsed: The notice period to the customer has not elapsed yet.
errors.in_flight: A charge for this surcharge is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
errors.invalid_state: The current status does not allow this operation (for example, the customer has no active authorization). Refresh the list.
errors.authorization_exists: The customer already has an active authorization for that method.
errors.consent_stale: The consent text has changed. Read it again and accept it again.
errors.method_unavailable: That payment method is not available for your gateway account.
errors.conflict: The operation conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
errors.other: The operation could not be completed. Try again.

propose.title: Propose a surcharge
propose.hint: The surcharge stays "to notify": nothing is notified or charged until you notify it. You can only propose it to your own company's customers.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero with up to 2 decimals.

authorizations.title: Charge authorizations
authorizations.intro: Permission each customer signs once so you can charge them surcharges with the saved method (card or SEPA debit) without them being present. The customer types the payment details on the gateway page: here you only see the brand and last 4.
authorizations.empty: There are no authorizations to show.
authorizations.revoke_body: No new surcharges can be charged to this customer with this authorization. Withdrawing permission is the customer's right and no money moves.

create.title: Register a charge authorization
create.hint: Use this only if the customer gives consent in person and it is documented. The customer will enter their card or IBAN on the gateway page, which opens in another window.
create.terms: Current terms: up to {charge} per charge and {month} per month; {notice} days' notice before charging and {dispute} days to dispute.
create.accept: The customer has read the text and accepts it (documented in-person consent).
create.processing: Waiting for the customer to complete sign-up…
create.processing_hint: When the gateway confirms it, the authorization becomes active. You can close this dialog: the final status will show in the list.
create.replayed: This request had already been sent: there is no new link. Wait for the customer to finish or register again.
create.expired: The gateway session has expired. Register again.

result.active: Authorization active. Surcharges can now be charged to this customer.
result.expired: The authorization expired without being completed.
